youtubeDescription: Discover Aquacellum, the app for aquarium enthusiasts and pro breeders alike. Navigate tanks, species, and tools with ease. Choose your mode and explore at your own pace.

beats.onScreen: Echo companion swims across the screen, introducing the app softly.
beats.narration: Welcome to Aquacellum. Your aquarium journey starts here.

beats.onScreen: The app's dashboard, showing tabs in Casual Hobbyist mode.
beats.narration: Aquacellum adapts to you. Casual mode or Pro Breeder tools—your choice.

beats.onScreen: Tabs for tanks, gallery, breeder tools, marketplace, and social reef.
beats.narration: Navigate tanks, species, tools, and a thriving community—all from one dashboard.

beats.onScreen: A user toggles to Pro mode, unlocking advanced tools.
beats.narration: Switch modes anytime. Pro unlocks breeding insights, genetics, and seller tools.

beats.onScreen: Poseidon AI floating in the interface, answering a care question.
beats.narration: Poseidon guides you. Tap for advice, or chat live in your tanks.

beats.onScreen: Echo whispers a nudge, pointing to a tank's care log.
beats.narration: Echo keeps casual mode friendly. Evolving as you grow.

beats.onScreen: Marketplace tab displays fish listings and buyer tools.
beats.narration: Browse, buy, and track orders. Pro sellers access the Breeder Terminal.

beats.onScreen: The Reef tab with social posts and care tips.
beats.narration: Connect with aquarists. Share, learn, and grow together.

beats.onScreen: Settings tab showing mode toggle and Echo preferences.
beats.narration: Personalize your experience. Switch modes, refine Echo, or give feedback.

beats.onScreen: Echo swims by as Poseidon gives a closing note.
beats.narration: Start your journey with Aquacellum. Dive in today.
